nodes.label: txt2img.py CLI
nodes.desc: Parses prompts and flags, builds the model from YAML config, runs the sampling loop, and tiles results into a grid.

nodes.label: load_model_from_config
nodes.desc: torch.load's the .ckpt, then instantiate_from_config walks the YAML to build the model tree.

nodes.label: LatentDiffusion
nodes.desc: The latent diffusion wrapper: first-stage VAE, conditioning encoders, and the simplified objective in p_losses.

nodes.label: DDIMSampler
nodes.desc: Deterministic DDIM sampling over the latent space with classifier-free guidance.

nodes.label: PLMSSampler
nodes.desc: Pseudo-linear multistep sampler, the default for the txt2img reference script.

nodes.label: UNetModel
nodes.desc: 860M-parameter U-Net that predicts the noise of a compressed latent given timesteps and text embeddings.

nodes.label: SpatialTransformer
nodes.desc: Transformer block wired into U-Net stages so image features can attend to text tokens.

nodes.label: CrossAttention
nodes.desc: The qkv attention where image features query the CLIP text embedding context.

nodes.label: AutoencoderKL
nodes.desc: KL-regularized first stage: encodes 512x512x3 images into 64x64x4 latents and decodes them back.

nodes.label: Encoder / Decoder
nodes.desc: ResnetBlock and AttnBlock stacks doing the actual pixel-to-latent compression and reconstruction.

nodes.label: FrozenCLIPEmbedder
nodes.desc: Frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 text tower turning prompts into 77x768 conditioning embeddings.
